objective.name: pilot.recover
objective.description: Explicit start of the continuities whose run died: examines the continuities of the Structure and wakes those that cannot go on by themselves, without creating any message or replaying any intention.

#root.role: Explicit start of the continuities whose run died: find those that cannot go on by themselves, then wake each with pilot.activate wake true.

continuity_ids._comment: Optional. Limits the examination to these continuities. Absent: every continuity of the Structure.

effects.continuities: Each woken continuity receives a wake activation; nothing else is written by this capacity.

transformation_contract.morphing: A set of continuities, some of which lost their run, becomes the list of those that were woken.
invariants: Nothing is woken unless this capacity is called: there is no start-up hook and no periodic pass.
Which continuities are woken is decided by continuity.stranded alone; this capacity decides nothing.
Waking is pilot.activate with wake true: no message is created and no intention is replayed.
When continuity_ids is given, only these continuities are examined.
success: woken lists the continuities that were woken, in the order of the Structure.
failure: A continuity that cannot be read is skipped and named in skipped; it does not stop the others.
notes: DSL orchestration: the calculation is continuity.stranded, the action is pilot.activate.
The DSL cannot derive a continuity_id from a Structure reference (no string operation), which is why finding the continuities is a capacity of its own.

#find.role: Find the continuities that cannot go on by themselves.

transformation_contract.morphing: The continuities of the Structure become the identifiers of those that need a run.
invariants: Only continuity.stranded decides who is stranded.

#wake.role: Wake each stranded continuity without waiting for it.

transformation_contract.morphing: A list of identifiers becomes as many wake activations.
invariants: Each wake is fire and forget: pilot.recover never waits for a run.
